note: Hub pages the discovery sweep reads, and the category it should file what it finds under.
Empty on purpose. Which sites this lab trusts enough to crawl weekly from its own address is
a decision for the lab, not a default somebody inherits -- and every entry here becomes a
recurring outbound request in the lab's name. Add the aggregators you already read.
Each source is { name, url, category, link_pattern? }. `category` is one of the board's own:
phd, internship, grants_awards, rising_stars, faculty -- taken from the hub rather than
guessed per link, because a page of fellowships is a page of fellowships. `link_pattern` is an
optional regex the candidate links must match, for a hub that lists more than opportunities.
